name: ChooseWow - Email 3: The Next Level
subject: When 5 minutes becomes 90 days
body:
✦ ChooseWow

Hey {{ .Subscriber.FirstName }},

Over the past week, you've gotten the 5-Minute Reset guide and heard about the habit that survived my craziest year.

I'm curious: Have you tried the practice? Even once?

(No judgment if you haven't — I know how it goes.)

Here's what I've learned after years of building habits: The practice that works is the one you actually do.

"I've tried meditation apps, elaborate morning routines, and sophisticated productivity systems. Most lasted 2-3 weeks. The simple practices? They're still with me."

But here's the thing about simple practices:

They work best when they have structure.

Not complicated structure. Just... intentional design. A framework that guides you through the hard days and celebrates the good ones.

Which brings me to something I've been working on.

The WowDay Journal

A 90-day guided gratitude practice

What if the 5-Minute Reset had a beautiful home? What if each day built on the last? What if you had gentle guidance for when gratitude feels impossible?

See what 90 days could look like →

I created WowDay because I wanted something between "complicated systems that fail" and "hoping good habits stick."

It's for people who:

  • Want to build a gratitude practice (but need structure)
  • Are tired of apps and want something tangible
  • Know that small, consistent actions create big changes
  • Are ready to commit to 90 days of intentional reflection

"90 days isn't arbitrary. It's roughly how long it takes for a new neural pathway to become automatic. Science meets simplicity."

The journal includes daily prompts, weekly reflections, and what I call "challenge days" — guided practices for when life gets hard.

It's beautiful, too. (Because if you're going to show up every day for 90 days, it should feel special.)

This isn't a sales pitch. You don't need to buy anything to get value from ChooseWow. I'll keep sharing insights and stories every week.

But if you're ready to go deeper — to turn those 5 minutes into a real transformation — WowDay might be for you.

Learn more about WowDay →

Either way, I'm glad you're here. Simple practices, done consistently, change everything.

— Janis

P.S. — Hit reply and tell me: What's one small win you've had this week? I love hearing about the good moments, big or small.
